subject.title: [Feature]: Add screenshot capture button to Control UI chat input (like Doubao)

question: Should core Control UI add a static screenshot-capture button, and what privacy boundary must it enforce before captured pixels enter chat attachments?
rationale: The implementation path is technically clear, but screen capture changes user consent, sensitive-data handling, browser-support, and provider-transmission expectations that code inspection cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Design static capture first
options.body: Approve implementation only after a small design covers browser permission, cancellation, preview/removal, redaction/logging, size limits, and relation to sensitive tool-media delivery.

options.title: Fold into screen sharing
options.body: Defer this button to the broader visual-capture direction tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99333.

options.title: Keep external capture
options.body: Decline a core capture button and keep the existing file, paste, and drop attachment flows as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Design static capture first
recommendation.body: Approve implementation only after a small design covers browser permission, cancellation, preview/removal, redaction/logging, size limits, and relation to sensitive tool-media delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent attachment work and are the best available routing candidate for the product/security boundary among the inspected history owners.
